stage: Post hoc sensitivity analysis after inspecting the fixed primary experiment
reason: Primary target-only RMSE was sometimes lower at5percent than at100percent and source pooling had mixed effects. Test dependence on target-site sampling without changing the primary results or selecting hyperparameters.
fixed: Reuse primary model settings, source pools, test quadrants, buffer, target weighting, and nested-subset rule. Full100percent subsets are identical for every subset seed and are not retrained.
report: Primary scores remain primary. Report the three-seed range as descriptive sample-selection sensitivity, not a confidence interval. Do not choose a seed based on its score.
